subject.title: Request: delete stale plugin entries claw-pay-plugin (v0.27, v0.25) from Publisher Plugins

question: Should the entire live `claw-pay-plugin` package be soft-deleted, or should only explicitly confirmed non-latest releases be permanently removed after reconciling the intended `claw-pay` survivor?
rationale: The issue requests destructive production changes, but the live registry no longer matches its versions, status, download count, or survivor description; automation cannot safely infer the intended records.

options.title: Confirm and soft-delete package
options.body: Ask the publisher to confirm that every live `claw-pay-plugin` release is obsolete, then withdraw the whole package through the reversible package-level flow.

options.title: Delete exact non-latest release
options.body: If only `0.2.6` is obsolete, obtain explicit confirmation and permanently delete that release while leaving `0.2.7` public.

options.title: Await corrected coordinates
options.body: Leave production unchanged until the publisher identifies the exact targets and intended surviving `claw-pay` record.

recommendation.title: Confirm and soft-delete package
recommendation.body: Ask the publisher to confirm that every live `claw-pay-plugin` release is obsolete, then withdraw the whole package through the reversible package-level flow.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the exact owner package-release deletion boundary that governs this decision.
